description: This file contains unit tests for the DrugsByNameComparator class, specifically testing the compare method for Drug objects based on their names.

classes.name: DrugsByNameComparatorTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple test cases for comparing Drug objects by name, ignoring numerical characters and other string considerations.

methods.name: compareDrugNamesIgnoringNumericals_shouldReturnNegativeIfNameForDrug1ComesBeforeThatOfDrug2
methods.description: Tests that the comparator returns a negative value when the first drug's name lexicographically comes before the second's.

methods.name: compareDrugNamesIgnoringNumericals_shouldReturnZeroIfNameForDrug1ComesBeforeThatOfDrug2
methods.description: Tests that the comparator returns zero when the drug names are considered equal case-insensitively.

methods.name: compareDrugNamesIgnoringNumericals_shouldReturnPositiveIfNameForDrug1ComesBeforeThatOfDrug2IgnoringDashes
methods.description: Tests that the comparator returns a positive value when the first drug's name is considered after the second's, ignoring dashes.

methods.name: compareDrugNamesIgnoringNumericals_shouldReturnPositiveIfNameForDrug1ComesBeforeThatOfDrug2IgnoringNumerics
methods.description: Tests that the comparator returns a positive value when numerical differences in drug names influence the comparison.
